Gujarat Municipal Corporation 
 
 Letter of Recommendation 
 
 
 Letter of recommendation 
 
 Our ref: 132 March 31, 2026 
 
 This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work "Handpump
 Installation - Gujarat Pkg-155" (INR 1.64 Cr), completed on August 28, 2024. On the basis of that
 
 engagement we record the following: 
 
 • Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
 • Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
 
 • Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site; 
 • Responsiveness of the contractor's site management. 
 
 We confirm that National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. executed the referenced work to our
 
 satisfaction. Their performance on schedule, quality, and safety was commendable.
 Verification: Manoj Desai, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000. 
 
 
 
 For Gujarat Municipal Corporation
